top_signals.title: Fed’s Waller Backs December Rate Hike, Open to Larger Move
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller on Tuesday said he supports an interest-rate hike in December, and warned that if inflation continues to accelerate he would support a half-percentage-point increase to protect the central bank’s credibility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
